title: Athletic Brewing 重塑啤酒消费新场景
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: For generations, beer has represented far more than what's in the glass.
segments.zh: 几代人以来，啤酒的意义远不止杯中物。

segments.en: It's been woven into the fabric of society from celebrations and sporting events to countless social rituals.
segments.zh: 它已融入社会肌理，从庆典、体育赛事到无数社交仪式。

segments.en: In recent years, consumers have begun to rethink their relationship with alcohol.
segments.zh: 近年来，消费者开始重新思考与酒精的关系。

segments.en: Do you have a favorite non-alcoholic beer on the menu?
segments.zh: 菜单上有你喜欢的无酒精啤酒吗？

segments.en: Raising a new question. Can beer still play the same cultural role if alcohol is no longer a part of the equation?
segments.zh: 提出新问题：若酒精不再参与，啤酒还能扮演同样的文化角色吗？

segments.en: Athletic brewing believes the answer is yes.
segments.zh: Athletic Brewing相信答案是肯定的。

segments.en: But rather than treating non-alcoholic beer as a compromise, the company has helped redefine it, as a category built around craft, flavor, and participation.
segments.zh: 但该公司并未将无酒精啤酒视为妥协，而是帮助重新定义它，围绕工艺、风味和参与感构建品类。

segments.en: It was really shifting consumer perceptions of what non-alcoholic beer could be or who it was for.
segments.zh: 这确实在改变消费者对无酒精啤酒可能是什么、为谁而做的认知。

segments.en: I think a lot of people probably never even considered a non-alcoholic beer until if it came around.
segments.zh: 我想很多人可能从未考虑过无酒精啤酒，直到它出现。

segments.en: Since its founding in 2017, Athletic has become the leading non-alcoholic beer brand in the US.
segments.zh: 自2017年成立以来，Athletic已成为美国领先的无酒精啤酒品牌。

segments.en: That's why I'm tapping founder and CEO Bill Schufeldt and his team to explore what it really takes to not only launch a competitive product
segments.zh: 因此我请来创始人兼CEO比尔·舒费尔特及其团队，探讨要推出有竞争力的产品，真正需要什么

segments.en: but to fundamentally alter consumer perceptions surrounding an entire category.
segments.zh: 以及如何从根本上改变消费者对整个品类的认知。
